content:
Hihi everyone, seeking for some help

I have several questions pertaining to mev-boost and its existence post ePBS 
My understanding is that we will likely see mev-boost running in parallel with ePBS 

In terms of reconciling execution layer rewards 

**pre-gloas **
1. mev relay data* (with some caveats) 

**post-gloas **
1. mev relay data 
2. beaconblockbody, specifically in https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md#new-process_execution_payload_bid

execution layer reward check post-gloas 
1. check whether process_execution_payload_bid indicates it is a ePBS block -> if yes, that eth1 block-number is ePBS 
2. if not, check mev relay data -> check onchain eth transfers to see whether payout corroborate with relay data  -> mev-boost block 
3. if not, likely a vanilla block (?)
